Interface Client

All Known Implementing Classes:
ClientMain
public interface Client
The Client interface serves as a marker interface for client-side components in the multiplayer game. It does not define any methods, but is intended to be implemented by classes that represent clients in the system.

By implementing this interface, a class signals that it represents a client in the context of the game's network communication. The specific functionality for client interactions with the server and game logic would be defined in the implementing class.
